title: Glowing top hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='g' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#b06bff'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#6a2fc4'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='brim' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#d9b3ff'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#8a4de0'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='band' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ffe98a'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#ffb020'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- brim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='38' ry='10' fill='url(#brim)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='75' rx='38' ry='10' fill='url(#brim)'/>
  <!-- crown -->
  <path d='M24 74 L28 26 Q50 20 72 26 L76 74 Q50 82 24 74 Z' fill='url(#g)'/>
  <!-- top highlight -->
  <path d='M28 26 Q50 20 72 26 L71 34 Q50 29 29 34 Z' fill='#d9b3ff'/>
  <!-- side shine -->
  <path d='M31 40 L32.5 66 Q37 68 41 68 L39 41 Z' fill='#c89cff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- band -->
  <path d='M25.5 64 L74.5 64 L75.2 70 Q50 77 24.8 70 Z' fill='url(#band)'/>
  <!-- buckle -->
  <rect x='45' y='64' width='10' height='8' rx='1.5' fill='#ff7ad9'/>
  <rect x='47.5' y='66' width='5' height='4' rx='0.8' fill='#8a2fb8'/>
</svg>
